THE ORDERING, WITH ITS NUMBERS. step() appends SysIdSample(now, room_temp, outdoor_temp, 0.0, self.phase) at sysid.py:302-304 and returns None during PHASE_SETTLING, so the pump is never overridden and settle rows carry real heat recorded as 0 kW; identify() keeps only PHASE_STEP and PHASE_RELAX at :377-379. At 30 min with 3 kW actually delivered: discarded (today) J=0.050, robust sd 0.759, clean UA error +0.009; used with power recorded correctly J=0.270, sd 0.169, +0.010; used with 3 kW recorded as 0 J=0.012, sd 1.447, clean UA error -0.064. Un-filtering as it stands is WORSE THAN THE BUG. With the power recorded, J goes 0.036 -> 0.288 (15 min), 0.057 -> 0.282 (30), 0.138 -> 0.426 (60) against floors 0.042/0.038/0.026, and robust sd 0.672 -> 0.121, 0.639 -> 0.135, 2.330 -> 0.090: 4.7-5.6x on sd, NOT an order of magnitude. The cadence ordering is settled and counter-intuitive -- finer sampling buys nothing, and 60 min is the worst cadence without the settle hour and the best with it.
